rules.name: Warlord
rules.description:
• If your Warlord dies all friendly Units within 8” must make a Panic Test (unless they are Immune to Panic).
• Every friendly Unit 8” from the Warlord may use his LD for Psychology Tests.

rules.name: Slow Time
rules.description:
Range: CC or LoS 
Level: 3 
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost:  1
Description: The Chronomancer delves into the strands of time, making them flow differently for his enemies.
Effect: Cast at the opposing model before it strikes in Close Combat. The enemy model gets the Strike Last Skill (if it already has this Skill then it cannot strike at all.) A normal Spell saving roll is allowed.

rules.name: Delve into the Future
rules.description:
Range: Self or friendly model in 20” and LoS
Level: 4
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost:  1
Description: The Chronomancer immerses himself into the ebb and flow of time, foreseeing incoming projectiles before they even leave their weapon.
Effect: Cast when a model receives a ranged attack. If successfully cast the Spellcaster or Spell target avoids the hit(s).

rules.name: Alternate Time Path
rules.description:
Range: LoS 
Level: 3 
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost:  2
Description: Some Chronomancers have mastered the command of time to such a level that they are able to change its course.
Effect: Target a model that just rolled a die. If successfully cast the target model must make a re-roll. Opposing models may make a normal Spell Saving Roll.

rules.name: Control
rules.description:
Range: Self
Level: 5
Type: Spell
Bond Cost:  2
Description: By accelerating and slowing time as they see fit, a Chronomancer is able to successfully command entire armies.
Effect: If successfully cast, gain 1 Command Point.

rules.name: Time Slow
rules.description:
Range: 30" and LoS 
Level: 6 
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 3
Description: Skilled Chronomancers have the ability to slow down time for their enemies.
Effect: Target an opposing unit. A save can be taken against this Spell as normal (WPLevel). If the opposing unit fails its save then it cannot make an Advanced Move this turn, treats Open Ground as Difficult Terrain and Difficult Terrain as Impassable Terrain.

rules.name: Time Warp
rules.description:
Range: LoS 
Level: 7 
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 3
Description: Skilled Chronomancers have the ability to create a bubble around their troops, increasing the speed of time for them.
Effect: Target a friendly Unit. If successfully cast, the unit can instantly make a Basic Move which does not count towards their activation. All movement modifiers still apply.

rules.name: Back to the Future
rules.description:
Range: Self or friendly model in 20” and LoS
Level: 8
Type: Ritual
Bond Cost:  5
Description: Some of the most accomplished Chronomancers are able to engulf themselves in a time bubble where they can freely roam the battlefield, with all other combatants frozen in time.
Effect: If successfully cast, remove the target model from the game. At the beginning of the next turn (Start of the Initiative Phase) place that model wherever you want to on the battlefield. If it is placed into a Clash Fight, put a Charge Token next to it.

rules.name: Future Plans
rules.description:
Range: Self
Level: 6
Type: Ritual
Bond Cost:  5
Description: Some of the most elaborate Chronomancy Spells are the ones that force an opponent into a position of vulnerability, seeing he is manipulated when it is already too late.
Effect: Cast before the start of a battle. You cannot use Command Points to boost this Spell. In the First turn, regardless of success or failure, the Chronomancer is treated as activated for the whole turn. If the Spell is successful you may deploy one of your opponents units in his deployment zone, and treat those models as activated (put an appropriate token next to them). Units with the Tactical Deployment Skill may also be deployed.

selectionEntries.name: Look into a Different Time Path

rules.name: Look into a Different Time Path
rules.description:
Range: Self or LoS 20”
Level: 6
Type: Spell
Bond Cost:  7
Description: The Chronomancer looks into another Time Path, bringing the best of it into their reality.
Effect: Target a friendly model (or yourself) in a Clash Fight. The target model receives a Charge Token.
